# dreyv — API context (scoped llms.txt)

> Scoped agent context for the dreyv REST API surface. For full product context see `/llms-full.txt`.

## Canonical specs
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://dreyv.com/openapi.json
- Plugin manifest: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- API catalog: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- Developer portal: https://dreyv.com/developers

## Auth
- Bearer JWT (SIWS) — issued via `/api/auth/*`
- API keys — provisioned at `/developers` (per-org, scoped)
- OAuth 2.0 (planned, beta) — see `/developers#oauth`

## Public endpoints (no auth)
- `GET /api/health`
- `GET /api/price?token=SOL`
- `GET /api/atlas/tokens`
- `GET /api/atlas/tokens/{symbol}`

## Authenticated endpoint families
- `/api/command/*` — natural-language treasury intents
- `/api/planner/*` — structured intent → plan
- `/api/simulate/*` and `/api/foresight/*` — fork simulation
- `/api/swap/*` — Jupiter quotes/execute (non-custodial)
- `/api/vault/*` — multisig balances and history
- `/api/squads/*` — proposal creation
- `/api/yield/*` and `/api/yields/*` — yield routing
- `/api/research/*`, `/api/tools/crawl`, `/api/tools/browser` — agent research
- `/api/dreyv-gateway/*` — provider-routed AI gateway

## Conventions
- All bodies JSON; UTF-8.
- All responses include `Link` headers (RFC 8288) pointing to api-catalog and service-desc.
- Errors follow RFC 9457 Problem Details when possible.
- Non-custodial: signing happens client-side; server returns sign-ready transactions.
